title: Threshold parity circuit
statement: Let $m\ge 7$. The threshold parity circuit on $2^m$ inputs has a first layer of AND gates given by the block minterms, followed by the specified middle layer and a singleton output layer.
caveat: The supplied statement refers to upstream constructions of the first and middle layers whose meanings are not included in the definitions.
